jobs.title: Senior Event Manager
jobs.companyDescription: A leading live-events and experiential agency delivering flagship conferences and brand activations across the GCC.
jobs.summary: Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale conferences and exhibitions across the UAE and wider Gulf region.
responsibilities: Own the full event lifecycle for exhibitions and conferences from brief to post-event reporting
Manage budgets of AED 1M+ and negotiate with venues, contractors and suppliers
Lead cross-functional teams of coordinators, production crew and on-site staff
Ensure compliance with UAE venue, licensing and health & safety requirements
requirements: 6+ years managing large exhibitions or conferences, ideally in the GCC
Proven budget ownership and supplier negotiation experience
Strong knowledge of Dubai World Trade Centre and ADNEC operations
Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage

jobs.title: Exhibition Stand Project Manager
jobs.companyDescription: Custom exhibition stand design and build specialists serving major trade shows in the Emirates.

Liaise with clients, designers and the workshop to hit show deadlines
Manage installation crews and enforce site safety standards
Track project costs and deliver stands on time and on budget
requirements: 4+ years in exhibition stand build or fit-out project management
Ability to read technical drawings and CAD layouts
Experience working to fixed trade-show deadlines
UAE driving licence preferred

jobs.title: Event Production Manager

Deep knowledge of AV, lighting and rigging systems
Comfortable leading crews under show-day pressure
